chapters.title: The Builder Mindset
chapters.summary: Rewire how you think before you touch a single tool.

lessons.title: What Is Vibe Coding?
lessons.goal: Understand the paradigm shift and why now is the best time in history to start building.
lessons.exercise: Write one sentence: what's the first thing you want to build?

lessons.title: Creator vs. Builder — Why Followers Aren't Enough
lessons.goal: See the difference between renting an audience and owning what you make.
lessons.exercise: List one thing you currently rent (a platform) and one thing you could own instead.

lessons.title: Mapping the Ecosystem: Claude, Cursor, v0, Bolt
lessons.goal: Get a mental map of the main AI building tools and know which one to reach for.
lessons.exercise: Pick the one tool you'll start with this week and say why in one line.

lessons.title: The Art of Talking to AI — Prompting Basics
lessons.goal: Learn three reusable prompt patterns that get better output every time.
lessons.exercise: Rewrite a vague request ("make me a website") into a specific, context-rich prompt.

chapters.title: Getting Set Up
chapters.summary: Create every account you'll need, the calm and simple way.

lessons.title: Create a Claude Account — Step by Step
lessons.goal: Sign up for Claude and land in the chat, ready to build.
lessons.exercise: Send Claude your first message and screenshot the reply.

lessons.title: A Tour of Claude — Chat, Artifacts, Projects
lessons.goal: Know where everything lives so the interface never slows you down.
lessons.exercise: Open a new Project and give it a name for your first build.

lessons.title: Your First Artifact: Build Something That Works in 60 Seconds
lessons.goal: Turn a single prompt into a live, working mini-app you can see.
lessons.exercise: Prompt Claude for a working countdown timer and watch it run.

lessons.title: A GitHub Account + What a "Repo" Actually Is
lessons.goal: Create a GitHub account and understand repositories in plain human language.
lessons.exercise: Create your first empty repository and name it after your project.

lessons.title: A Cloudflare Account — The Future Home of Your Sites
lessons.goal: Set up Cloudflare so you're ready to put things on the internet later.
lessons.exercise: Sign up for Cloudflare and find the Pages section in the dashboard.

chapters.title: Your First Website
chapters.summary: Go from a prompt to a real personal page you can share.

lessons.title: Your First Landing Page with Artifacts
lessons.goal: Build a personal landing page from a prompt — no setup required.
lessons.exercise: Generate a one-screen landing page with your name and a headline.

lessons.title: Prompting for Design: Reference, Theme, Font, Feel
lessons.goal: Describe the look you want so the AI nails the vibe, not just the text.
lessons.exercise: Rebuild your page with a specific reference site and mood in the prompt.

lessons.title: Iteration: How to Ask for Changes Without Breaking It
lessons.goal: Make surgical edits that improve the page instead of scrambling it.
lessons.exercise: Change only the color scheme of your page in a single, precise prompt.

lessons.title: What Are HTML & CSS? (Just Enough to Understand, Not Write)
lessons.goal: Read the structure of a page well enough to direct the AI with confidence.
lessons.exercise: Point at three parts of your page and name whether they're structure or style.

lessons.title: Your First Publish: From Artifact to Shareable Link
lessons.goal: Get a real link to your page that anyone can open.
lessons.exercise: Publish your page and send the link to one friend.

lessons.title: Project: Your Personal Brand Landing Page
lessons.goal: Ship a polished personal landing page you're proud to share.
lessons.exercise: Publish your finished landing page and post the link publicly.

chapters.title: A Real Site on the Internet
chapters.summary: Put a project on GitHub, deploy it live, and give it your own domain.

lessons.title: Upload a Project to GitHub (No Terminal — From the Browser)
lessons.goal: Get your project files onto GitHub using only the web interface.
lessons.exercise: Upload your landing page files to a new GitHub repository.

lessons.title: Deploy with Cloudflare Pages — Your Site Is Live
lessons.goal: Connect your repo to Cloudflare Pages and get a live URL.
lessons.exercise: Deploy your repo and open the live *.pages.dev link.

lessons.title: Buy a Domain and Connect DNS (Simple and Visual)
lessons.goal: Get a custom domain and point it at your live site.
lessons.exercise: Connect a custom domain to your Cloudflare Pages site.

lessons.title: Making Your Site Multi-Page
lessons.goal: Add more pages and link them so the site feels complete.
lessons.exercise: Add an About page and link it from your home page.

lessons.title: Contact Forms and Social Links
lessons.goal: Let visitors reach you with a working form and clear links.
lessons.exercise: Add a contact form that sends you a message when submitted.

lessons.title: Project: A Full Portfolio on Your Own Domain
lessons.goal: Ship a complete multi-page portfolio living on a domain you own.
lessons.exercise: Publish your portfolio on your domain and share it.

chapters.title: Claude Code: The Builder's Main Tool
chapters.summary: Graduate from the browser to the tool real builders use every day.

lessons.title: What Is Claude Code and Why It's a Game Changer
lessons.goal: Understand what Claude Code does and why it unlocks bigger projects.
lessons.exercise: Write down one project too big for Artifacts that Claude Code could handle.

lessons.title: Install: WSL on Windows, Step by Step
lessons.goal: Get a working Linux environment on Windows without fear.
lessons.exercise: Open WSL and run a command to confirm it's working.

lessons.title: Your First Project with Claude Code
lessons.goal: Start Claude Code in a folder and build your first thing with it.
lessons.exercise: Ask Claude Code to create a small script and run it.

lessons.title: Understand Your Files and Project Structure (Reading the Map)
lessons.goal: Recognize what the folders and files in a project are for.
lessons.exercise: Have Claude Code explain your project's folder structure to you.

lessons.title: Git with Claude Code: Commit, Go Back, Rescue a Project
lessons.goal: Save checkpoints and safely undo mistakes with Git.
lessons.exercise: Make a commit, break something, and roll back to the commit.

lessons.title: Debugging: When It Breaks, Fix It Like This
lessons.goal: Turn error messages into a calm, repeatable fixing routine.
lessons.exercise: Paste an error into Claude Code and follow the fix to green.

lessons.title: Project: Rebuild Your Site — This Time with Claude Code
lessons.goal: Recreate your portfolio in Claude Code and deploy it fresh.
lessons.exercise: Rebuild and redeploy your site entirely from Claude Code.

chapters.title: Interactive Apps
chapters.summary: Move beyond static pages into apps that remember and react.

lessons.title: App vs. Site — "State" in Plain Language
lessons.goal: Understand what makes something an app: it remembers and reacts.
lessons.exercise: Name one everyday app and describe what "state" it keeps.

lessons.title: Your First App: A Caption / Hashtag Generator for Creators
lessons.goal: Build a working tool that turns input into useful output.
lessons.exercise: Build a generator that outputs 5 hashtags from a topic you type.

lessons.title: Saving Data: Why Refresh Wipes Everything and How to Fix It
lessons.goal: Persist data so a page reload doesn't erase your work.
lessons.exercise: Make your app remember its last result after a refresh.

lessons.title: What Is an API — The Front Door to the World's Data
lessons.goal: Understand APIs as a way for your app to ask other services for data.
lessons.exercise: In one sentence, describe what data your dream app would fetch.

lessons.title: Connecting to a Real API: Live Crypto Prices
lessons.goal: Fetch and display live data from a real public API.
lessons.exercise: Show the live price of one coin that updates when you refresh.

lessons.title: Project: A Creator Tool (Engagement Calculator / Link-in-Bio)
lessons.goal: Ship a real interactive tool creators would actually use.
lessons.exercise: Deploy your creator tool and share the live link.

chapters.title: Tools & Agents
chapters.summary: Build things that run on their own, around the clock.

lessons.title: Build a Telegram Bot — Without Writing a Single Line of Code
lessons.goal: Create a working Telegram bot you can message and get replies from.
lessons.exercise: Create a bot that replies to a command you send it.

lessons.title: Automation: Work That Runs Itself Every Day (cron)
lessons.goal: Schedule a task so it runs automatically on a timer.
lessons.exercise: Schedule a job that runs once a day and logs the time.

lessons.title: What Is an Agent — AI You Give a Job To
lessons.goal: Understand agents as AI that takes actions toward a goal you define.
lessons.exercise: Write a one-line job description for an agent you'd hire.

lessons.title: Your First Agent: A Personal News Reader
lessons.goal: Build an agent that gathers and summarizes news for you.
lessons.exercise: Build an agent that summarizes today's top item in your niche.

lessons.title: VPS: Your Own Cloud Computer (Rent, Connect, Run)
lessons.goal: Rent a small server, connect to it, and run something on it.
lessons.exercise: Connect to a VPS and run a command that prints its hostname.

lessons.title: Project: A Personal Bot / Agent That Runs 24/7
lessons.goal: Deploy an agent to a server so it keeps working without you.
lessons.exercise: Deploy your bot to a VPS and confirm it responds while your laptop is closed.

chapters.title: The Professional Builder
chapters.summary: Sell what you build, launch in public, and stay safe.

lessons.title: Monetization: Sell Your Tool (Models + Payments)
lessons.goal: Pick a pricing model and add a way to take payments.
lessons.exercise: Add a working payment button to one of your tools.

lessons.title: Launching on X: Build in Public, the Nabulines Way
lessons.goal: Announce your work in a way that earns attention and trust.
lessons.exercise: Draft a launch post for your tool with a clear hook and link.

lessons.title: Basic Security: API Keys, Scams, and Wallets
lessons.goal: Protect your keys, money, and accounts with simple habits.
lessons.exercise: Move one exposed secret out of your code and into a safe place.

lessons.title: Final Project: From Idea to Public Launch
lessons.goal: Take one idea all the way from blank page to a public launch.
lessons.exercise: Launch one finished product publicly and share the link.

lessons.title: What's Next? A Map of Advanced Paths
lessons.goal: Know your options for going deeper and pick a next direction.
lessons.exercise: Choose your next path and write the first step you'll take.
